text:
clare: quick post-all-hands thread on GPU capacity, regions, and autoscaler behavior. i promised a short follow-up.
tom: thanks. can we get clarification on which GPU SKUs will be in APAC pilot? people keep asking T4 vs A10g.
clare: APAC pilot will initially include T4s for burst and A10g for reserved Dedicated pools in select zones (e.g., ap-northeast-1a, ap-southeast-1b). exact zone list next Tuesday.
viv: autoscaler ordering question: if reserved is empty but prewarm exists, do we always prefer prewarm?
clare: yes — decision order is reserved (committed) -> prewarm (warm pool) -> burst (spot/partner) -> model fallback. prewarm is preferred over burst to avoid variability.
miguel: ops needs a deterministic prewarm sizing formula, not just a flat number.
clare: suggested formula: prewarm_slots = ceil((route_qps * expected_p95_latency_s) * safety_factor). example: qps=20, p95=0.5s -> 20*0.5=10 -> *1.5 safety = 15 slots. start defaults for major regions but teams should supply route_qps.
alice: when burst uses spot pools and we get evicted, what latency hit do we expect? will we failfast?
clare: eviction flow: immediate attempt to reroute to prewarm/reserved; if not available, route to quantized/smaller model variant (typically ~1.5x latency). only if all fallbacks exhausted do we return 503. we also queue up to 250ms while trying fallbacks.
tom: billing — will prewarm for hosted customers be visible as a separate line item?
clare: yes. hosted customers will see a "prewarm" charge line; Dedicated customers get prewarm included in their commit. we are adding a per-route toggle prewarm_opt_out for teams that don't want auto-prewarm.
viv: any change to canary windows after last week's hiccups?
clare: yes, updated canary policy: small routing canary 45m + 2h scaling observation with synthetic traffic during the window. ops will run the synthetic after 10m to catch immediate regressions.
miguel: please publish a one-page GPU-pressure runbook and the on-call paging matrix. ops needs names and escalation steps.
clare: action: publish "GPU pressure playbook" by Friday. owner: miguel. will include alert thresholds (GPU util >85% sustained 5m), paging matrix, and mitigation checklist (prewarm bump, route throttles, degrade to smaller models).
alice: will Console show prewarm utilization and cross-region overflow stats?
clare: Console roadmap: prewarm utilization, burst % usage, and per-route cross-region overflow will be in beta dashboards in ~2 weeks.
tom: can product teams get an example autoscaler config to start from?
clare: dropping an example below — feel free to copy and tune.
clare: ```yaml
autoscaler:
  min_replicas: 1
  max_replicas: 50
  warm_target_latency_ms: 300
  prewarm_pool_slots: 20
  burst_threshold_qps: 80
  scale_up_rate: 2x_per_minute
  scale_up_cooldown_s: 25
  scale_down_cooldown_s: 240
  eviction_queue_ms: 250
  fallback_policy:
    - reserved_capacity
    - prewarm_pool
    - burst_spot
    - fallback_model: quant-1.5B
```
ops-bot: added notes + deck -> https://redwood.company/all-hands/2026-03-20 (deck v10.3). :spiral_notepad:
clare: follow-up: we're scheduling a 30m route-mapping sync Tue 10am PT to collect route_qps and latency targets. invite from miguel. please DM route names if you can't make it.
miguel: confirmed owner for playbook and calendar invite sent.
clare: thanks all
